title: Lubricants & Streamlining
description: The final showdown! Reduce friction to spin the Momentum Core back to life and end Baron Standstill's reign.

content.value: A LUBRICANT is a substance (like oil or grease) applied between surfaces to reduce friction. It fills the tiny bumps and forms a thin slippery layer so the surfaces slide easily instead of catching on each other. This is why we oil bicycle chains and machine parts.

WITHOUT lubricant:  bumps catch → high friction → wear + heat
WITH lubricant:     oil fills bumps → surfaces glide → low friction

Liquids and gases are called FLUIDS. Fluids also cause friction on objects moving through them — this is called DRAG. A swimmer feels water pushing back; a cyclist feels air resistance. Drag increases with speed, so it costs more energy the faster you go.

To cut drag, fast-moving things are given a special smooth, tapered shape called a STREAMLINED shape. Aeroplanes, cars, boats, and even birds and fish have streamlined bodies so fluids flow past them easily, reducing friction and saving energy.
Nature discovered streamlining first! Fish and birds evolved sleek, tapered bodies to move through water and air with the least drag — long before engineers copied the idea.

Key Takeaway: Lubricants (oil, grease) reduce friction between solid surfaces. Fluids cause drag on moving objects, which is reduced by giving them a streamlined shape — as seen in planes, fish and birds.

quiz.question: A lubricant such as oil reduces friction by…
options: forming a slippery layer that fills the tiny bumps
quiz.explain: Lubricants fill the surface irregularities and form a thin slippery layer, so surfaces slide easily.

quiz.question: The friction force on an object moving through air or water is called…
quiz.explain: Fluids (air and water) exert a frictional force called drag on objects moving through them.

quiz.question: Aeroplanes and fish have streamlined shapes to…
options: reduce drag from air or water
quiz.explain: A streamlined (smooth, tapered) shape lets fluids flow past easily, reducing drag and saving energy.
